spec.hypothesis: Decisions with relative_q80 >= 0.002 are the H100 marketplace-ask origins plus the most active H100_80GB neocloud and H100_SXM origins (q80 up to 0.0026). Always-narrow beats medium on marketplace (0.0560 vs 0.0616) and on H100_80GB neocloud (0.0126 vs 0.0136). The 0.002 cutoff is higher than the 0.0005 and 0.001 cutoffs that were not programmable, so it should add only a few neocloud origins to the marketplace class. That makes it a different set from every earlier proposal. It leaves the flat A100 and hyperscaler series untouched.
